segments.title: December
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! December is the Party Season Survival Guide. Office parties, family dinners, and a January that is coming whether we like it or not. This month we help members get through the season, and set up the new year before it starts.

segments.title: ₹1.7L
segments.text: So, the number. Our December target for Pop-up is 1.7 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent more than last December. Ambitious, yes. Unreasonable, no.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? New clients lead the way with 81,500 rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then renewals 74,600, comebacks 11,800, and everything else 1,700. New clients carry this month, so every trial is a first impression worth getting right.

segments.title: 45 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 527 leads, 137 trials, and 45 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. Every five trials should become about one member. Make those first classes unforgettable.
Here's where the offers come in. Four offers carry 82,600 rupees, which is 49 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Boxing Day (Gloves Optional)
segments.text: First up, Boxing Day. Gloves optional. Two days only, twelve-class packs at twenty per cent off. Stock up before January. The plan is 5 buyers at about 6,800, so 34,000 rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: pack buyers, members topping up, newcomers.

segments.title: The Gift They Won’t Regift
segments.text: Next, the Gift They Won't Regift. A boxed gift: two classes, grip socks, and a thousand rupees off a first membership. Offices buying ten get a team class. The plan is 4 buyers at about 1,200, so 4,800 rupees.
segments.notes: Members and non-members buying for someone new; offices.

segments.title: The Ex-Files: Season Finale
segments.text: Then, for lapsed members, The Ex-Files: Season Finale. Ten per cent off to come back, fifteen on three months, and a plus-one to the NYE Countdown Class. The plan is 2 buyers at about 6,600, so 13,200 rupees.

segments.title: The Advent-ure Calendar (Opens in January)
segments.text: And finally, the Advent-ure Calendar, which opens in January. Renew in December and take home twelve doors of perks, one a week from the third of January: guest passes, a private, smoothies and a golden door. Perfect for the hardest quarter. The plan is 4 buyers at about 7,700, so 30,600 rupees.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Advent-ure Calendars and gift boxes go on sale. Week two, every December renewal hears the calendar pitch, and offices get their gift boxes. Week three, a mid-month check against the target. Week four, Boxing Day packs, and the NYE Countdown Class for our comeback members.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's December at Pop-up. 1.7 lakh rupees, four offers, and 45 buyers to welcome. That's a wrap on 2027. See you on the mat in January.
